run_mutual_info_regression: run mutual_info_regression to estimate mutual information between features and a continuous target variable
run_mutual_info_classif: run mutual_info_classif to estimate mutual information between features and a discrete target variable
run_compute_mi_cc: run _compute_mi_cc to compute mutual information between two continuous variables using k-nearest neighbors
run_compute_mi_cd: run _compute_mi_cd to compute mutual information between a continuous and a discrete variable
run_estimate_mi: run _estimate_mi to estimate mutual information between each feature column and a target vector
